TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS AND SCOPE OF WORK FOR 70 TONS HYDRAULIC BLANK CUTTING POWER PRESS: A. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS: The supplier is required to design, supply, install & commission Hydraulic Blank Cutting Power Press 70 Tons fulfilling following technical specifications. 1) Press Type: Precision Blanking Press 2) Thrust force: 70 Ton 3) Dimension of strips/Blanks to be cut: a) Width 10 to 100mm b) Thickness 0.65 mm to 5 mm. 4) Strips metal: a) Pure Gold and Silver & its alloy, b) Quaternary Alloy (Ag-50%, Cu -40%, Ni -5%, Zn - 5%), c) Cu-Ni (75%-25%) 5) Strokes per minute: Min. 15 to 16 strokes per minute, Up & Down, Stroke ad justment. 6) Operation mode: Slide motion for positioning of dies i.e. tool change or adju stment mode (inching mode); Single cycle operation mode, Foot & Inching Op erating System. 7) Operational Controls: Control Method: Manual control, semi-automatic, or f ully automated control system. Specify the control features, such as start/sto p buttons, speed control, emergency stop, etc. 8) Operation: Foot & Inching operating system.

9) Tooling: Machine shall be supplied along with separate tooling for cutting o f the blanks of following dimensions with maximum yield: a) Embossing Die Set with Cutting Die required for the finished medal sizes of Ø2 7 mm, 35 mm, 44 mm • Tool set must perform Fine Cutting operation i.e. blanks must be free from burrs, Strip separator to separate the strip from the punch aft er every cycle of blanking operation. b) Tooling must have arrangement for scratch free blanks cutting. c) No. of tool sets: 2 for each denominations along with their drawings for the fin ished medal sizes of Ø27 mm, 35 mm, 44 mm 10) Blanks collection: Provision of gentle collection of cut blanks without damagi ng its surface is required. 11) Hydraulic system: Press Frame: Heavy-duty steel frame construction for rigi dity and stability 12) Die Change System: Quick and efficient die change system for minimizing do wntime during product changeovers. 13) Safety Features: a) Emergency Stop: Easily accessible emergency stop button or lever to quickly s top the mill operation in case of emergencies. b) Safety Guards: Protective enclosures or guards to prevent operator contact wit h moving parts. c) Overload Protection: System to protect the mill from excessive loads or overlo ading. B. OTHER SPECIFICATIONS: 1) Safety features & suitable Fault finding system shall be provided. 2) All the electrical devices shall be energy efficient, easy to maintain and of l atest technology proven in the market and not on the verge of obsolescence. 3) Acoustic Noise Protection (< 75 DB) shall be provided. 4) IGMH shall Provide Supply of Electricity and water. Civil work and all the au xiliaries and accessories require for operating the machine shall be in the sco pe of the supplier. 5) Machine should be Energy efficient, maintaining power factor of more than 0.9 and should comply with BEE guidelines. 6) Bidder should provide sales and service support including supply of spares and consumables for minimum 10 years from the date of Final Acceptance Cer tificate (FAC). Bidder has to submit undertaking for this. 7) Anti-vibration pads for base of the machine must be supplied by the firm, if required.

C. DOCUMENTATION: 1) Successful bidder will have to provide soft and 3Nos. hard copies of Operati ng and Maintenance manual (Mechanical, Hydraulic & Pneumatic) in English al ong with spare part catalogue, drawings. 2) Successful bidder will have to provide foundation and machine lay out draw ing including electrical cable/air/oil and water trench details. D. INSTALLATION, SETUP AND TRAINING: 1) Successful bidder shall include installation, testing commissioning and succ essful trail run of the machine as per the specification mentioned in tender at worksite of purchaser. 2) Successful bidder shall provide the onsite training to 6 members of IGMH e mployee for 3 working days (eight hours per shift) at respective machine inst allation site after successful commissioning of the machine. E. The seller must notify the buyer when the goods are ready for this in spection. The goods will only be dispatched after they have cleared in the PDI. G. FINAL ACCEPTANCE TEST: 1) After successful installation and commissioning of the machine, FAT will be carried out in presence of bidder’s representative/engineer for two (2) workin g days at installation site as per the specifications and quality parameters as mentioned in this tender document. 2) The date of FAT will be decided on mutual agreement. 3) FAT shall be carried out for two working days in single shift of 8 hours with minimum output for Gold/Gold Alloys and Silver/ Silver Alloys, testing will be c arried out on 27/35/44 mm blanks with a speed of 15 strokes/minutes. 4) During period of FAT, the firm has to depute their Engineer for monitoring and recording the test result. 5) Performance test shall be carried out for all functional, quality, operational and safety interlock check by the successful bidder for the machine. 6) Test certificates from NABL or International Standard Certificate for Tooling Material. 7) Final Acceptance Certificate (FAC) shall be issued after successful FAT. H. SCOPE OF WORK: The scope of this procurement encompasses the design, manufacturing, supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of one (1) Hydraulic Blank Cutting Powe r Press, 70 Ton as per the detailed technical specifications. The successful bidde r's responsibilities shall include the following: 1) Supply of Equipment: To provide one Hydraulic Blank Cutting Power Press, 70 Ton, complete with all necessary auxiliaries and accessories required for it s operation. Including tool sets required for each denomination, supplied alon g with their drawings for the finished medal sizes of Ø27 mm, 35 mm, and 44 mm. 2) Civil Works: To provide detailed foundation and machine layout drawings, i ncluding specifications for electrical, air, oil, and water trenches. The scope of supply includes all civil work necessary for the machine's foundation. 3) Installation and Commissioning: To perform the complete installation, testi ng, and commissioning of the machine at the India Government Mint, Hyderab ad (IGMH) worksite. This includes a successful trial run to ensure the equipme nt meets all specified performance parameters.

4) On-site Training: To provide on-site training to 6 members of IGMH employe es for three working days (eight hours per shift) following the successful com missioning of the machine. 5) Documentation: To supply three hard copies and one soft copy of the compr ehensive Operating and Maintenance manuals in English. This documentation must include a spare parts catalogue and all relevant drawings. 6) Testing and Certification: a) Facilitate a Pre-dispatch Inspection at the seller's premises, providing necessa ry in-house testing facilities free of cost. b) Conduct a Final Acceptance Test (FAT) at the IGMH site for two working days, d emonstrating minimum output for Gold/Gold Alloys and Silver/Silver Alloys. Speci fically, testing must be conducted on 27/35/44 mm blanks at a speed of 15 stroke s/minute and verifying all functional, quality, operational, and safety interlock ch ecks. c) Provide NABL or International Standard test certificates for the Tooling Materi al. 7) Purchaser's (IGMH) Responsibilities: a) IGMH will provide the necessary supply of electricity and water for the machin e's operation. b) During commissioning, IGMH will provide access to tools such as gas cutting eq uipment, welding machines, hand grinders, drills, and material handling equipm ent (e.g., Forklift etc..), as well as two helpers. c) The buyer will bear the fees for any nominated external inspection agency and external laboratory testing charges required during the pre-dispatch inspection. I. WARRANTY AND SERVICE SUPPORT: 1) Warranty Period: The equipment must be covered by a warranty for 12 mon ths from the date of supply or installation.
